runs.text: Online messages are often public, or at least easy to screenshot, so every reply is a little advertisement for your hotel. Guests have also grown used to fast service, and their patience online is short. Studies of social media service have found that a large majority of people who reach out expect a reply within an hour, yet only a minority of businesses actually manage it. That gap is your opportunity, because a quick, kind reply genuinely stands out.

heading_path: Online and Social Media Customer Service

runs.text: Good to know: research suggests that around three quarters of customers who message a brand on social media expect a response within the hour. Speed really is part of the service now. See the further reading at the end of this chapter.
